arabic_text: وَمُفَوِّضٌ فِي ذٰلِكَ كُلِّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمُسَلِّمٌ فِيهِ مَعَكُمْ
transliteration: wa mufawwidhun fi dhalika kullihi ilaykum. wa musallimun feehi ma'akum.
english_text: and I confide all that to you and submit to all of it with you.

arabic_text: وَقَلْبِي لَكُمْ مُسَلِّمٌ وَرَأْيِي لَكُمْ تَبَعٌ وَنُصْرَتِي لَكُمْ مُعَدَّةٌ حَتَّىٰ يُحْيِيَ ٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ دِينَهُ بِكُمْ
transliteration: wa qalbī lakum musallimun wa ra'yiyyu lakum taba'un. wa-nus'ratī lakum mu'addah. ḥattā yuḥyiyallāhu taʿālā dīnahu bikum.
english_text: My heart is subservient to you, my opinion is following yours, and my support to you is all set until Allah the All-exalted restores His religion to life through you,

arabic_text: وَيَرُدَّكُمْ فِي أَيَّامِهِ وَيُظْهِرَكُمْ لِعَدْلِهِ وَيُمَكِّنَكُمْ فِي أَرْضِهِ
transliteration: wa yaruddakum fi ayyamih. wa yuzhirakum li 'adlihi. wa yumakkinakum fi ardihi.
english_text: brings you back again in His days, allows you to appear for (establishing) His justice, and gives you power to rule in His land.

arabic_text: فَمَعَكُمْ مَعَكُمْ لَا مَعَ غَيْرِكُمْ
transliteration: famaʿakum maʿakum. lā maʿa ghayrikum.
english_text: So, I am (always) with you, with you, but not with any one other than you.

arabic_text: آمَنْتُ بِكُمْ وَتَوَلَّيْتُ آخِرَكُمْ بِمَا تَوَلَّيْتُ بِهِ أَوَّلَكُمْ
transliteration: 'āmantu bikum. wa tawallaytu akhirakum bima tawallaytu bihi awwalakum.
english_text: I have full faith in you, and I declare my loyalty to the last of you just as I declared it to the first of you.

arabic_text: وَبَرِئْتُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مِنْ أَعْدَائِكُمْ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبْتِ وَٱلطَّاغُوتِ وَٱلشَّيَاطِينِ وَحِزْبِهِمُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ لَكُمْ
transliteration: wa baritu ila allahi ʿazza wa jalla. min ʾaʿdāʾikum wa min al-jibt wa al-ṭāghūt. wa ash-shayāṭīn wa ḥizbihimu aẓ-ẓālimīn lakum.
english_text: In the presence of Allah the Almighty and All-majestic, I repudiate your enemies, all idols, false deities, the devils, and their party who have wronged you,

arabic_text: ٱلْجَاحِدِينَ لِحَقِّكُمْ وَٱلْمَارِقِينَ مِنْ وِلاَيَتِكُمْ وَٱلْغَاصِبِينَ لإِرْثِكُمْ ٱلشَّاكِّينَ فِيكُمْ
transliteration: al-jāhidīna li-ḥaqqikum. wa al-marīqīna min wilāyatikum. wa al-ghāṣibīna li-irthikum. alshaakkīna feekum.
english_text: denied your rights, apostatized from your (divinely commissioned) leadership, usurped your inheritance, arisen doubts about you,

arabic_text: ٱلْمُنْحَرِفِينَ عَنْكُمْ وَمِنْ كُلِّ وَلِيجَةٍ دُونَكُمْ وَكُلِّ مُطَاعٍ سِوَاكُمْ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَئِمَّةِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ إِلَىٰ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: al-munḥarifīna ʿankum. wa min kulli waliyyahin dūnakum. wa kulli muta'a'in siwakum. wa min al-a'immah alladheena yad'uuna ila al-nnari.
english_text: and deviated from you, and (I repudiate) any adherence to anyone other than you, any obeyed one save you, and the leaders who call to Hellfire.

arabic_text: فَثَبَّتَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ أَبَداً مَا حَيِيتُ عَلَىٰ مُوَالاَتِكُمْ وَمَحَبَّتِكُمْ وَدِينِكُمْ
transliteration: fa thabbatanīya allāhu abadan mā ḥayītu. ʿalā muwālatikum. wa mahabbatikum wa deenikum.
english_text: May Allah make me firm forever as long as I am alive on loyalty to you, love for you, and on your religion.

arabic_text: وَوَفَّقَنِي لِطَاعَتِكُمْ وَرَزَقَنِي شَفَاعَتَكُمْ وَجَعَلَنِي مِنْ خِيَارِ مَوَالِيكُمْ ٱلتَّابِعِينَ لِمَا دَعَوْتُمْ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: wa waffaqanī li-ṭāʿatikum. wa razaqanī shafāʿatakum. wa jaʿalani min khīyāri mawālīkum. al-tābiʿīn limā daʿawtum ilayh.
english_text: May He grant me success in obedience to you, endue me with your intercession, make me of the best of your loyalists who carry out all that to which you have called,

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَنِي مِمَّنْ يَقْتَصُّ آثَارَكُمْ وَيَسْلُكُ سَبِيلَكُمْ وَيَهْتَدِي بِهُدَاكُمْ وَيُحْشَرُ فِي زُمْرَتِكُمْ
transliteration: wa jaʿalanī mimmanni yaqtassu āthārakum. wa yasluku sabeelakum. wayahtadī bihudākum. wa yuḥsharu fī zumaratikum.
english_text: and make me of those who are tracking your footsteps, taking your path, following your guidance, (and those who are) resurrected in your group,

arabic_text: وَيَكِرُّ فِي رَجْعَتِكُمْ وَيُمَلَّكُ فِي دَوْلَتِكُمْ وَيُشَرَّفُ فِي عَافِيَتِكُمْ وَيُمَكَّنُ فِي أَيَّامِكُمْ
transliteration: wayakirru fi rajʿatikum wa yumallaku fi dawlatikum. wa yusharrafu fi ʿafiyatikum. wa yumakkanu fi ayyamikum.
english_text: given the chance to appear again in your Return, given authority in your administration, honored to live under your sound supervision, given power in your days,

arabic_text: وَتَقِرُّ عَيْنُهُ غَداً بِرُؤْيَتِكُمْ
transliteration: wa taqirru ʿaynuhu ghadan bi-ruʾyatikum
english_text: and having their eyes delighted by seeing you in the morrow.

arabic_text: بِأَبِي أَنْتُمْ وَأُمِّي وَنَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
transliteration: bi-abi antum wa ummi. wa nafsi wa ahli wa mali.
english_text: May my father, mother, soul, family, and possessions be ransoms for you.

arabic_text: مَنْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهَ بَدَأَ بِكُمْ وَمَنْ وَحَّدَهُ قَبِلَ عَنْكُمْ وَمَنْ قَصَدَهُ تَوَجَّهَ بِكُمْ
transliteration: man arada allahabad'a bikum. wa man wahhadahu qabila 'ankum. wa man qasadahu tawajjaha bikum.
english_text: Whoever desires for Allah should begin with you, whoever professes His Oneness should accept your instructions, and whoever heads for Him should make you the means to Him.

arabic_text: مَوَالِيَّ لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَائَكُمْ وَلاَ أَبْلُغُ مِنَ ٱلْمَدْحِ كُنْهَكُمْ وَمِنَ ٱلْوَصْفِ قَدْرَكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ نُورُ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
transliteration: mawālīya lā uḥṣī thanākum. walā ʾablughu min al-madḥi kunhakum. wa min al-waṣfi qadrakum. wa antum nooru al-akhyaar.
english_text: O my masters, I cannot count your merits and I cannot attain the utmost of praise of you and the utmost of the description of your actual value, since you are the light of the upright ones,

arabic_text: وَهُدَاةُ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ وَحُجَجُ ٱلْجَبَّارِ
transliteration: wa hudātu al-abrār. waḥujajul jabbar.
english_text: the guides of the pious ones, and the arguments of the Supreme Lord.

arabic_text: بِكُمْ فَتَحَ ٱللَّهُ وَبِكُمْ يَخْتِمُ
transliteration: bi-kum fatḥa allah. wa bikum yakhdimu.
english_text: With you has Allah begun creation and with you will He seal it.

arabic_text: وَبِكُمْ يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ وَبِكُمْ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَاءَ أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ وَبِكُمْ يُنَفِّسُ ٱلْهَمَّ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلضُّرَّ
transliteration: wa bikum yunazzilu al-ghayth. wa bikum yumisku as-samaa'an taqa'aa ala al-ardhi illa bi-idhnihi. wa bikum yunaffisu alhamma. wa yakshefu al-ḍurru.
english_text: For your sake does He pour down rain, for your sake does He withhold the heavens from falling on the earth except by His permission, and out of consideration for you does He dismiss agonies and relieves harms.

arabic_text: وَعِنْدَكُمْ مَا نَزَلَتْ بِهِ رُسُلُهُ وَهَبَطَتْ بِهِ مَلاَئِكَتُهُ
transliteration: wa ʿindakum mā nazalat bihi rusuluhu. wa habaṭat bihi malāʾikatuhu.
english_text: In your possession is all that which His Messengers brought down and with which His angels descended.

arabic_text: وَإِلَىٰ جَدِّكُمْ بُعِثَ ٱلرُّوحُ الأَمِينُ
transliteration: wa'ilā jaddikum buʿitha al-rūḥu al-amīn.
english_text: To your forefather( ) was the Honest Spirit sent.

arabic_text: آتَاكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَا لَمْ يُؤْتِ أَحَداً مِنَ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
transliteration: atākumullāhu mā lam yuʾti aḥadan min al-ʿālamīn.
english_text: Allah has given you that which He has not given to any one all over the worlds.

arabic_text: طَأْطَأَ كُلُّ شَرِيفٍ لِشَرَفِكُمْ وَبَخَعَ كُلُّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لِطَاعَتِكُمْ وَخَضَعَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ لِفَضْلِكُمْ وَذَلَّ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ لَكُمْ
transliteration: ṭaʾṭaʾa kullu sharīfin li sharafikum. wa bakhaa kullu matakabbirin li-ta'aatikum. wa khadaʿa kullu jabbārin li-faḍlikum. wa dhal-la kullu shay'in lakum.
english_text: All highborn ones nod down their heads before your noble lineage, all arrogant ones submit to the obedience to you, all insolent oppressors succumb to your excellence, all things are humiliated before you,

arabic_text: وَأَشْرَقَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِنُورِكُمْ وَفَازَ ٱلْفَائِزُونَ بِوِلاَيَتِكُمْ
transliteration: wa-ashraqatil-arḍu bi-nūrikum. wa fāza al-fāʾizūna bi wilāyatikum.
english_text: the earth has been lit up with your light, and the winners have attained triumph due to their loyalty to you.

arabic_text: بِكُمْ يُسْلَكُ إِلَىٰ ٱلرِّضْوَانِ وَعَلَىٰ مَنْ جَحَدَ وِلاَيَتَكُمْ غَضَبُ ٱلرَّحْمٰنِ
transliteration: bikum yuslaku ila al-ridhwani. wa ʿalā man jaḥada wilaayatakum ghaḍabu ar-raḥmaan.
english_text: Through you can the way to Paradise be taken and the ire of the All-beneficent is poured on whoever has denied your (divinely commissioned) leadership.

arabic_text: بِأَبِي أَنْتُمْ وَأُمِّي وَنَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
transliteration: bi abi antum wa ummi. wa nafsi wa ahli wa mali.
english_text: May my father, mother, soul, family, and possessions be ransoms for you.

arabic_text: ذِكْرُكُمْ فِي ٱلذَّاكِرِينَ
transliteration: dhikrukum fi al-dhakireen.
english_text: your mention is within the mention of others.

arabic_text: وَأَسْمَاؤُكُمْ فِي ٱلْأَسْمَاءِ
transliteration: wa asmāʾukum fī al-asmāʾi.
english_text: Your names are called along with other names.

arabic_text: وَأَجْسَادُكُمْ فِي ٱلْأَجْسَادِ
transliteration: wa aj'sadukum fi al-ajsad.
english_text: Your figures appear among other figures.

arabic_text: وَأَرْوَاحُكُمْ فِي ٱلْأَرْوَاحِ
transliteration: wa-arwāḥukum fī al-arwāḥi.
english_text: Your souls are among other souls.
